column1: # The Notation Reference's PDF, MEASURED at wave LD4 (2026-08-19) and READ before freezing.
# Rendered from the SAME Texinfo pass as the HTML, so the pictures in this file are the
# very SVGs notation.html shows -- which is what decision D51's ruling actually says.
# PAGES              1,272 at A4. ⚠ Frozen BESIDE the page size on purpose: a manual that
#                    silently reverted to US Letter would move this number and nothing
#                    else, leaving a page count with two candidate explanations.
# PAGE_*_PT          595 x 842, from HtmlRenderOptions.SetPageSize("A4"). True A4 is
#                    595.276 x 841.890; the helper is a tenth of a millimetre narrow.
#                    ⚠ Also asserted from the FILE's own /MediaBox values -- see
#                    NotationReferenceRenderTests.every_page_of_the_pdf_is_a4, because an
#                    options-side check could never fail.
# SVG_RASTER_SCALE   2.0, the package's shipped default, RECORDED not chosen. Effective
#                    density is 96 CSS dpi x 2 = 192 ppi, and MEASURED placement is the
#                    SVG's own physical size in millimetres (snippet-00001 declares
#                    139.04mm x 99.5707mm and lands 1052 x 752 px at 192 ppi).
# KEEP_UNCOVERED     TRUE as of wave LD5 -- decision D56, RULED. It was false here through
#                    wave LD4, and the change moved NOTHING in this manual: the switch
#                    governs HTML TEXT, and every drop this file ever recorded was in SVG
#                    text instead. ⚠ Since 2026-08-28 there are no drops here at all (see
#                    below), so this row records a setting rather than an explanation.
#                    ⚠ AND THE MANUAL IT WAS PARKED FOR DID NOT DECIDE IT EITHER.
#                    music-glossary -- the one manual carrying music symbols in PROSE, which
#                    LD4 named as the place this switch would finally matter -- drops
#                    nothing at all: the NotoMusic package on Html2Pdf's per-glyph fallback
#                    chain covers its flats and sharps, and its PDF earns zero PDF-stage
#                    warnings. So the ruling is about the NEXT uncovered character rather
#                    than about any character in this corpus, and it is VISIBLE: a character
#                    that silently disappears is invisible to the visual QA this phase is
#                    accepted on. The package gives the kept case its own warning code
#                    (font.uncovered.kept), so these rows stay exact either way.
# THE DROP ROWS -- one per DISTINCT code point, with an exact occurrence count, which is
# the surface TexinfoPdfWarnings.PdfItems was added to this repository's chain to provide.
# A total would go on passing while one character stopped dropping and another started.
# ⚠ THE 22 HEBREW DROP ROWS ARE GONE AS OF 2026-08-28, AND THE CAUSE IS AN ENGINE FIX.
# They were U+05D0-U+05EA, the Hebrew half of a Hebrew/Bulgarian lyric example
# (input.itely, engraved as snippet-01161), and this file recorded them as an accepted
# D47 coverage gap. THEY WERE NOT ONE. They were a PORT DEFECT wearing D47's clothes:
# the engine emitted an uncovered character into the SVG text, which 2.27.2 does not
# emit at all, and the Html2Pdf chain then found no font for it and dropped it once per
# occurrence -- which is what this file was counting. The A2a fix (2026-08-28, the
# Mutopia round) made an uncovered character measure as Pango's unknown-glyph box
# instead of .notdef's empty box, and with it the engine stopped emitting the character.
# MEASURED on that same lyric, under the regression corpus's own font pinning, rather
# than argued:
#     pinned oracle 2.27.2    0 Hebrew characters in the SVG, and 24 `no glyph for
#                             character' warnings
#     port WITH the fix       0 Hebrew characters, and the SAME 24 warnings -- upstream's
#                             wording and font name, character for character
#     port WITHOUT the fix    24 Hebrew characters emitted into the SVG: the divergence
# So the loss did not become invisible, which is the thing this header has always been
# careful about. It MOVED to the engine stage, where upstream puts it, and it is louder
# there: 24 occurrences each named with its code point and font against 22 code points
# counted here. The corpus agrees independently -- utf-8.svg carries this same lyric and
# moved from GLYPHS-DIFFER to MATCH at that fix, and the diagnostics gate grades those
# warnings 2,146 of 2,146. D47 still covers the coverage gap itself; what this file no
# longer records is the port defect that was hiding inside it.
# ⚠ WHAT IS *NOT* HERE IS THE POINT OF PdfTextFallback. The first LD4 render dropped 26
# code points / 29 occurrences: the 22 Hebrew rows described above, since removed, plus
# Greek Psi/alpha/omega and U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW twice. The SVG text path's per-glyph
# fallback chain contains only Noto Music unless a consumer says otherwise -- so the flat
# in snippet-01349 was rescued while the arrow beside it was not, and a Greek run styled
# `serif' dropped in the SVG while the identical run renders in HTML. Four
# AddFallbackFamily calls closed it. If those four ever stop being registered, the Greek
# and the arrow reappear as DROP rows here, which makes this baseline the control for
# that registration. ⚠ AS OF 2026-08-28 THAT IS THE ONLY THING THE DROP SECTION WATCHES,
# and the section is empty -- so any DROP row appearing here at all is now a finding.
# It still works for its purpose: the Greek and the arrow ARE covered by the port's own
# faces, so the engine emits them and it is the PDF chain's fallback that rescues them.
# SVG_PLACEMENT      Vector -- decision D51 AMENDED 2026-08-26 (Texinfo2Pdf 1.0.238.626 ->
#                    Html2Pdf 1.0.238.580): every engraved picture is placed as PDF VECTOR
#                    content, its text as embedded-font text, through a fully managed
#                    engine. Set explicitly and READ BACK, so a package that changed its
#                    default would move this row. RE-FROZEN AT THAT BUMP AND NOTHING ELSE
#                    MOVED: PAGES, both warning counts, every DROP row and the snippet
#                    counts are identical to the raster route's. SVG_RASTER_SCALE stays
#                    recorded but now governs only a part PDF cannot express (none here).
# CFF_SUBSET         Compact -- Texinfo2Pdf 1.0.243.66 (Html2Pdf 1.0.243.38) added a THIRD
#                    PdfCffSubsetMode beside None, the package default that embeds a CFF
#                    face whole, and Sparse, which keeps only the glyphs the document uses:
#                    Compact also empties the subroutines and strings those glyphs do not
#                    need. Set explicitly in ManualRenderer.ApplyPdfOptions and READ BACK
#                    off the live options, exactly as SVG_PLACEMENT is.
#                    ⚠ INERT FOR THESE MANUALS, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: pdffonts over
#                    all nine PDFs finds every embedded face to be already-subset CID
#                    TrueType -- Merriweather, Roboto, Roboto Mono, Noto Serif, Noto Music
#                    -- and NOT ONE Type 1C / FontFile3 face anywhere, because the engraved
#                    music arrives as PDF vector path operators rather than as text set in
#                    a CFF face. The setting is made anyway for the day a CFF face DOES
#                    reach a manual, and so that a package which changed its default moves
#                    this row instead of silently changing the PDFs.
#                    RE-FROZEN AT THAT BUMP AND NOTHING ELSE MOVED: PAGES, both warning
#                    counts, the page size, every DROP row and the snippet counts are
#                    identical to 1.0.240.201's.
CFF_SUBSET
KEEP_UNCOVERED
PAGES
PAGE_HEIGHT_PT
PAGE_WIDTH_PT
PDF_ITEMS
PDF_WARNINGS
SVG_PLACEMENT
SVG_RASTER_SCALE
